source_message:
feat(adapters): Commercial adapter stubs — Dow Jones / Sumsub / Chainalysis, 28 tests

- dowjones_adapter.py: DowJonesAdapter (PEP/sanctions), ScreeningResult,
  PEPResult (with relatives & associates); STUB mode raises NotConfiguredError
  with vendor onboarding instructions; LIVE mode calls DJRC REST API;
  to_risk_signal() maps hits to RiskSignal (authority: SAMLA 2018 / FCA MLR 2017)
- sumsub_adapter.py: SumsubAdapter (KYC/KYB), VerificationResult, KYBResult;
  HMAC-SHA256 signed requests; verify_document/verify_kyb/get_applicant_status;
  REJECTED → requires_mlro=True; authority: FCA MLR 2017 §28
- chainalysis_adapter.py: ChainalysisAdapter (crypto AML KYT), WalletRiskResult,
  TransactionRiskResult; 0-10 risk score → SEVERE/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW categories;
  SEVERE + sanctions_exposure > 10% → requires_mlro=True;
  authority: FCA Cryptoasset AML / FATF VASP Travel Rule
- All adapters: from_env() config, NotConfiguredError with DOC/onboarding msg,
  is_configured property, STUB/LIVE mode property
- 28 tests covering STUB behaviour, config, to_risk_signal() mapping

Full suite: 747/747 passed
